title: Vindicators: Crystal War
description: Magnesium Man and the Vindicators finally face off with Chinnos who is trying to get his hands on the Doomsday app.
quote: I can restart this planet in flames, as a utopia.
altHero: Chinnos, a blue villain, flying in the air and holding a smartphone
alt1: shark hero jumping toward Chinnos who is in a pink safety bubble in the air
alt2: Chinnos ready to restart the Doomsday app as the Vindicators look on
